sources: amazon.com search: watch roll travel case 3 slot
verdict: REJECTED on RULE 2. Under the 'prepaid' basis it clears the contribution floor at $49, but $49 is far above the band (median $30.46, ceiling $35.03). Priced INTO the band at $32 it fails RULE 1 instead at $6.13/unit. Above the market or below the margin, with nothing in between - that is the whole failure mode, and the two rules catch each end of it. Category is NOT locked: top review count 626.
dutyRateBasis: HTS 4202.92.97 (case, outer surface of plastic sheeting or textile): 17.6% MFN + 25% Section 301 List 3 + 12.5% forced-labour action effective 2026-07-24. Sourced, not inherited.
costSource: DSers My Products, read 2026-09-03. DSers is what we are charged and it is not always the AliExpress listing price.
